title: UK and EU race to agree a deal before next week's summit
summary: Prime Minister Andy Burnham says the talks will "go down to the wire".
body:
Britain and the European Union are trying to finish a package of agreements before a UK-EU summit in Brussels on 20 November.

Prime Minister Andy Burnham met the president of the European Commission, Ursula von der Leyen, on Thursday 12 November. He said afterwards that the talks looked set to "go down to the wire".

What is on the table

  • Less paperwork for food exports between Britain and the EU.
  • A link between the two sides' carbon emissions trading schemes.
  • A scheme to let young people live and work in each other's countries for a time.

One remaining difficulty is an EU request for its students to pay lower fees at British universities. Von der Leyen said she wanted "a summit of ambition and concrete results".

Sources: AFP, as carried by Yahoo News and the Bangkok Post.
